set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H03.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Storage/lifecycle engineer
Scope: Build reusable lifecycle mechanics using an explicit local engineering policy while reserving institutional policy acceptance for O04.2.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H03 (bd-01M4X8M9CTMTKZHBKG8T9E8EDS)
Suggested delivery tranche: T3; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inventory active references from retained releases, staging, derivatives, delivery/run leases and registered backups; classify shared/live/abandoned/held references without double counting bytes or deleting a live reference.
2. Implement a versioned local synthetic retention/hold/backup-expiry profile with audit and operator reports; reclaim only proven abandoned staging, and keep canonical-blob garbage collection disabled.
3. Reject admission of data requiring unqualified physical erasure; distinguish withdrawal, unavailable bytes and actual deletion. Verify holds, shared blobs, expiry races and repeated cleanup without claiming institutional policy compliance.

Verification: Reference/reachability fixtures and concurrent lease/cleanup/expiry cases; explicit rejection of unsupported-erasure data and auditable disposition reports.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H03.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O04.1: bd-01M4W5P9WHJFTH2K179GXKEFW3
- H03.1: bd-01M4X8MA9J2FXA82A9RVB85YD9
- O02.4: bd-01M4W5P8JRY7KB6KQJREBCXEAN

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H03.2: Implement retention reference accounting and a safe erasure admission boundary
